text:
Maya: wow that all-hands felt like a midnight variety show - big bravo to everyone :clap:
Ben: can confirm. my cat judged the ukulele performance and approved :cat_with_wry_smile:
Lina: who brought the moonpie? iconic snack choice :crescent_moon::cookie:
Raj: not me, but i will accept credit. moonpie diplomacy is real.
Zoe: serious question - donuts for SF folks tomorrow or send a 'midnight snack box' to remote teammates? poll?
Maya: remote box pls, shipping saves lives :package:
Ben: donuts are a nostalgia trap. remote box for the win.
Chris: i'll take whatever. moonpie + coffee = peak content.
Lina: ops-bot, spin up snack poll and remind rooftop meetup tomorrow at noon?
ops-bot: Poll created: "Snack preference" (Donuts / Remote box / Moonpie). Closes in 24h. Rooftop meetup reminder set for 12:00 PST. Recording saved: https://drive.example/allhands/1745550000
Raj: shoutout to infra for the smooth demo deploy. zero hiccups = instant applause :tada:
Ben: also shoutout to Maya's improv on the Q&A, chef's kiss :ok_hand:
Maya: team improv was a team effort tbh. also shoutout to whoever queued the kazoo clip, made me snort-laugh.
Zoe: i clipped the kazoo -> https://media.example/kazoo-clip, remix incoming in #media
Chris: can we add a soft moonlight harp under it? ambient 2000 vibes.
Lina: vote: moonlight harp or toaster oven percussion? 
Ben: toaster oven percussion if it comes with cookies.
Raj: i'll bring mini marshmallows for s'mores if rooftop weather behaves.
Maya: RSVP: rooftop noon, count me in.
ops-bot: Reminder queued and calendar invites sent to attendees who RSVP in this thread.
Zoe: final thought: best all-hands energy in a while. logging off happy :sparkles:
Maya: good night y'all, hydrate and stretch those thumbs :stretch:
Ben: night!
Lina: night :crescent_moon:
Chris: end of thread"
